property_summary: For any caller address newOwner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) on the correct contract only succeeds when the caller is the current owner and results in owner() == newOwner; the mutant inverts onlyOwner so a non-owner can call transferOwnership and the owner() after the call can differ (i.e. the call behavior/ownership change differs for some callers).
change_summary: Change onlyOwner to check caller is NOT the owner, inverting the guard so transferOwnership can be called by non-owners and altering ownership outcomes.
